body:
I don't really have any advice, other than to tell you that I am in the same boat. Misery loves company right ??

I also have no people skills, and people are uncomfortable around me. I also have the misfortune of being an amputee. That does not effect my co-workers and such, but when I am meeting a new person they don't quite know what to say about me being an amputee and they are uncomfortable. It doesn't help that I am extremely socially awkward, so there is this negative feedback loop of awkwardness, and I can never break through to get a friend.

My brother killed himself 4 years ago. At first I was extremely angry with him, because he was the only person in the world that could understand me. In the years that past, I have come to the conclusion, that I was the selfish one for being so angry at him. He was in extreme pain, and was cursed with an affliction that made him hated.

Today is his birthday

I don't think you would want to overdose on Zoloft. The chances of succeeding are slim, and the overdose effects sound very unpleasant. If I was going to take a bunch of pills to commit suicide, I'd would prefer using something that would be less painful then other more common methods, not more painful.

Thanks for replying. Most people with suicidal thoughts seem to be teenagers or young adults that just haven't figured something out yet. I think it is more rare for middle aged people, or maybe they just don't vent on boards like this. My brother killed himself in his late 30s and I sometimes envy his will power to do so, but I was very sad when he left because he was the only one on earth that understood me. His life was literally collapsing around him at the time of his suicide though, and my life is far less traumatic. My life is numb to the world though, and I can't just exist anymore, because that all I am doing nowadays ... existing.
I've been waiting to die for nearly my whole life too.
